title: Inclusive lesson planning
assignment: Develop an inclusive lesson plan and justify its teaching and assessment decisions. GenAI may draft activities and suggest resources; disclose accepted suggestions. Checkpoints assessing independent performance allow no GenAI during delivery.
ai_permissions: Develop an inclusive lesson plan and justify its teaching and assessment decisions. GenAI may draft activities and suggest resources; disclose accepted suggestions. Checkpoints assessing independent performance allow no GenAI during delivery.
budget_scope: Additional checkpoint work; existing product marking excluded

requirements.description: Justify a teaching strategy against that learner need.
Revise assessment after a new classroom constraint. Each requires one individual demonstration; justify revisions using the stated context.

checkpoints.name: Misconception response
checkpoints.prompt: A: A learner says heavier objects always fall faster; identify what you would ask to diagnose the reasoning. C: Your planned assessment becomes inaccessible to a learner; propose an alternative and justify its fit to the outcome. E combines diagnosis, strategy and assessment revision in one unfamiliar case. Candidate: Misconception response.
checkpoints.conditions: E1 Diagnose an unfamiliar misconception. E2 Justify a teaching strategy against that learner need. E3 Revise assessment after a new classroom constraint. Each requires one individual demonstration; justify revisions using the stated context.
checkpoints.ai_permissions: Develop an inclusive lesson plan and justify its teaching and assessment decisions. GenAI may draft activities and suggest resources; disclose accepted suggestions. Checkpoints assessing independent performance allow no GenAI during delivery.
checkpoints.mapping_rationale: Score diagnosis, contextual justification and assessment fit separately. D and F provide context only. A fluent reflection cannot satisfy E1–E3 under the stipulated independent-performance conditions.

approval.reviewer: Original development fixture; expert review pending

expected_narrative: A + C costs 170 minutes and S = 20; E alone costs 160 minutes and S = 20. E is the cheapest complete combination in this expanded library. At budget 160 it remains feasible; at 159 no complete plan is feasible. This extends the four-candidate protocol example: adding E correctly changes its previous 170-minute minimum.
